title: Spiral Staircase of Dreams
description: A woman in an ornate silver-grey Victorian gown stands on a surreal spiral staircase made of film reels, looking back over her shoulder. The scene is a fantastical painted mural featuring burning ships in a stormy sea, floating open books with dancing figures, dripping paint, scattered film strips and rose petals on the steps, and a glowing yellow banner reading 'FOLLOW-ALONG REEL 135'.
prompt: A woman in a flowing ornate silver Victorian ballgown stands on a winding spiral staircase constructed from film reels and strips, turning to look back with a neutral expression. The walls are a painted surreal mural showing burning tall ships on a dark stormy sea, large open books floating with silhouettes of dancing figures inside, dripping colorful paint, scattered rose petals and film strips on the steps, with a glowing yellow banner that says FOLLOW-ALONG REEL 135, dark moody fantasy atmosphere.
